personas.line: What does the conversation actually do?

passages.text: It didn't really feel like a normal tone. It felt like...? — Rejection.
It feels like she's ignoring... my boundary.
Like the way I reacted... was... over-the-top.
This business of... coming close to someone is a place of... great vulnerability.
I just want to be near you... and you're, like, pushing me away.
I'm not being the perfect guy that you were so excited about moments ago?
I felt like she kind of put me into one.
That might be one of the... old stories that's getting reworked here.

keyFinding: Personas agreed perfectly and added no unique analysis. Given clear instructions, Claude matched that accuracy, and few-shot examples were the only component that moved the ambiguous line.
whatChanged: Homework buried results in screenshots. The portfolio rebuilds the 7/8 table as an ablation stepper and surfaces the passage-5 / −Examples flip the slide skipped.
